description: This file defines functions and types related to channel model overrides, including resolving provider entries, building channel candidates, and resolving channel model overrides based on configuration and session context.

methods.name: resolveProviderEntry
methods.description: Resolves the provider entry for a given channel from the model by channel configuration, normalizing the channel name for matching.

methods.name: buildChannelCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate keys and parent keys for channel matching based on provided parameters, including session and group context.

methods.name: buildFeishuParentOverrideCandidates
methods.description: Generates fallback candidate strings for Feishu channels based on raw ID patterns.

methods.name: resolveChannelModelOverride
methods.description: Resolves the channel model override configuration based on parameters, configuration, and fallback matching logic.
